THREAT BRIEFING // HALCYON-9

THREAT · HIGH

THE HOLLOW

Station crew reanimated by a bioluminescent parasite. Slow at first. By round eight, they sprint.

THREAT · VOLATILE

BURSTER

Bloated with unstable spores. Detonates on death or when it reaches you — and takes other Hollow with it.

THREAT · EXTREME

JUGGERNAUT

Every fifth round. Fused armor, charges on sight. The molten core in its chest takes triple damage.

HOW TO SURVIVE: Earn points on every hit and kill. Spend them to open doors, buy weapons off the wall, gamble at the Reliquary, restore Primary Power in the Reactor Hall to wake the perk pods, then feed 5,000 to the Overcharge Forge. Your shield recharges if you break contact — your health doesn't forgive as fast.
